conflicts.permit: Google may use the collected data to contextualize and personalize the ads of its own advertising network.
conflicts.prohibit: These third parties have access to your Personal Data only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.
conflicts.situation: When Google Analytics (a third-party Service Provider) accesses Personal Data collected from the Service.
conflicts.reason: The policy states Service Providers may only use data on the company's behalf and not for other purposes, but explicitly states Google uses it for its own ad network.
